title: Youth Congress protest inside Meta's Raidurgam office; 21 taken into custody

slides.head: Youth Congress protest inside Meta's Raidurgam office; 21 taken into custody
What happened
slides.body: Police said around 25 activists entered the access-controlled Sky View premises around 3 pm, raised slogans and staged a sit-in; TOI reports flower pots in a corridor were damaged.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Protesters said Meta blocked the social media accounts of Youth Congress leaders Uday Bhanu and Manish Sharma and demanded they be restored.

slides.head: Taken into preventive custody
slides.body: All 21 were released on bail the same day after giving sureties.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Police said about 25 activists entered the access-controlled Sky View premises around 3 pm.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether Meta restores the blocked accounts or responds publicly. Ask: What should a platform disclose when it blocks a politician's account?

captions.instagram:
Youth Congress protest inside Meta's Raidurgam office; 21 taken into custody

Telangana Youth Congress members protested at Meta's office in Raidurgam on Friday over blocked accounts of two national Youth Congress leaders; police said state president Jakkidi Shiva Charan Reddy and 20 others were taken into preventive custody.

Why it matters: Protesters said Meta blocked the social media accounts of Youth Congress leaders Uday Bhanu and Manish Sharma and demanded they be restored.

Source: Times of India. Image: Times of India
